title: Creative Designer, Junior
note: Dental products company; marketing and packaging design.

facts.summary: Entry-level in-house designer at a Schaumburg dental-materials maker, covering labels, packaging and marketing materials.
facts.duties: Designs and revises product labels and packaging, keeping them compliant with regulations, and handles vendor/printer proofs; creates marketing collateral and ads; supports other departments and company events.
facts.requirements: Adobe Creative Cloud and MS Office on Mac and PC; basic branding/marketing sense; schedule 7:30am–4pm M–F; can lift up to 35 lb.
facts.apply: Apply via BISCO's ApplyToJob page with resume and portfolio.
